# Flinthead arrow

Internal ID: ArrowFlint | Type: Arrow | Source: Workbench | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Flint x2, Feathers x2

# Introduction

Flinthead arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from wood arrows.

## Availability

• Made at the workbench, requiring a workbench level of 2 or above.

Categorias: Weapons, Arrows, Workbench recipes
